senses.gloss: (√בז, v. בְּזֵי II; cmp. בצע, פצע &c.) to split, perforate, rend.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 37:29">Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 29</cite> (ed. Berl. Pa.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:13">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:8:3">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵈ</cite> top <he>ובְזָעוֹן</he> and rent them (his garments); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:1:4">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵃ</cite> top <he>ובזעיה</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:5">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to II, 17</cite> (expl. <he>בצע אמרתו</he> <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">ib.</cite>) <he>פורפיריה ב׳</he> He rent His purple (allowed the Temple curtain to be cut through by Titus).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:15">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 15</cite>; a. e. (Var. Pe., v. supra).—Part. pass. <he>מְבַזַּע</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 9:4">Targ. Josh. IX, 4</cite>.—Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top <he>מאנוי מבזעין</he> his garments torn. Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵃ top <he>והיא מְבַזְּעָא בידיה</he> and it (the wine botte) bursts in his hand; v. infra.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 16:31">Targ. Num. XVI, 31</cite>; a. fr. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ top <he>א׳ ימא וכ׳</he> the lake of Tib. was split.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>מִתְבַּזַּע</he>. Ib. II, 41ᶜ top <he>אתבזעת זיקיה</he> his wine bottle burst. Ib. V, 45ᵃ top <he>והיא מִיבַּזְּעָא בידיה</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 36a:12">Bekh. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>איבזע׳ שיפתיה</he> his lip was slit; a. e.
